title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary: Bitcoin holds at sixty-three thousand four hundred sixty-six dollars with fear entrenched at twenty-seven on the index. Miners show conviction as hashrate reaches eight hundred twenty-two point eight exahashes per second. Mempool congestion hits eighty-seven thousand transactions yet fees remain suppressed at two sat per vbyte, pointing to steady network capacity. US morning action stays muted, down just one-tenth of a percent over twenty-four hours with no fresh catalysts. Block height advances
